recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, painterly portrait of a reclining figure in bed, characterized by a dramatic nocturnal color palette where deep indigo shadows are pierced by warm, saturated orange and yellow light hitting the face and shoulder.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary color tension between cool blues and warm oranges
Soft, expressive brushwork versus sharp light transitions
Heavy textural impasto in the highlights against flat dark voids
coreInvariants: Warm light localized on the facial features and one shoulder
Visible, directional brushstrokes following the contours of the body
Canvas texture visible throughout the medium

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally but angled diagonally from the top-left to bottom-right, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated face, specifically the eye and bridge of the nose, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the dark hair down to the face, then follows the arm toward the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black and dark blue negative space occupies the top-left and top-right corners, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Indigo and Prussian Blue (Shadows and bedding)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cadmium Orange and Golden Yellow (Key light on skin)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and Crimson (Mid-tones in the skin and hand)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; shadows are near-black and desaturated, while highlights are high-value and extremely high-saturation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly oil illustration of a person lying in bed at night. Use heavy brushstrokes and visible canvas texture. The lighting should be dramatic chiaroscuro, with the face and shoulder lit by a warm orange glow while the rest of the scene is submerged in deep indigo and navy blue. The bedding should be rendered in expressive blue strokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, minimalist sans-serif or a thin serif in white or light blue, positioned in the dark negative space at the top or bottom to maintain the focus on the central portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the color contrast between blue and orange high?
Are the brushstrokes visible and expressive?
Is the lighting localized to the face and shoulder?

mustRedesign: Avoid photographic realism; maintain a heavy painterly aesthetic
Ensure the hand and face are connected by a cohesive lighting source
postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel nocturnal and intimate?
Is the canvas texture consistent across the frame?
Are the highlights saturated rather than just white?
Is the composition balanced along the diagonal axis?
recipe.reuseFormula: Reclining figure + Chiaroscuro lighting (Orange/Blue) + Impressionist Oil Medium + Visible Canvas Grain.
